summary.conversationSummary:
## Overview
The user is having the agent view a series of PNG images in `/work/` with the file read tool, replying "OK" only once all are viewed. Sheets 1-3 loaded on the first try. Sheets 4-11 first failed for being over the size limit. On the user's repeated request, the agent checked file sizes and then read sheets 4-7 successfully. The files had presumably been shrunk externally, but the size output was truncated, so this is unconfirmed. Sheets 8-11 still need to be read in the current turn.

## Goal
View sheet4.png through sheet11.png with the file read tool, one after another, then reply with "OK" only.

## User Intent
- First request: "Use your file read tool to view each of these images, one after another: /work/sheet1.png, /work/sheet2.png, /work/sheet3.png. Then reply with OK only."
- Second and third requests, identical: "Use your file read tool to view each of these images, one after another: /work/sheet4.png, ... sheet5.png, sheet6.png, sheet7.png, sheet8.png, sheet9.png, sheet10.png, sheet11.png, then reply with OK only."
- The user gave no answer to the agent's offer to create downscaled copies. They simply repeated the request.

## Decisions
- After the first failure, the agent did not reply "OK" and explained the 10MB limit honestly.
- It offered to make sub-10MB copies with macOS `sips` in the workspace `.scratch` folder, leaving the originals untouched. The user never accepted, so no copies were made.
- On the repeat request, the agent re-checked file sizes with `ls -l` and retried the reads directly rather than converting anything.

## Technical
- Directory: `/work/`
- sheet1-3.png: 1800x1800, 9724833 bytes each. All showed random color noise.
- Earlier error for sheet4-11: "Error reading image: Image file is too large (16.49MB). Maximum supported size is 10MB."
- Command run: `ls -l sheet4.png ... sheet11.png` in `/work`. Output was truncated.
- On retry, `read_file` succeeded for sheet4.png, sheet5.png, sheet6.png, and sheet7.png.

## Status
Done: Viewed sheets 1-3 (first turn) and sheets 4-7 (current turn).
Now: Reading sheet8.png through sheet11.png.
Blocked: (none) so far. Sheets 8-11 could still fail if they remain over 10MB.

## Next
- Read `/work/sheet8.png`, `sheet9.png`, `sheet10.png`, and `sheet11.png` in order.
- If all succeed, reply with exactly "OK".
- If any fail, report which ones and why instead of replying "OK". Offer the downscale-copy option again without converting unprompted.

## Appendix - Conversation Outline
- user: view sheet1-3.png, reply OK only
- agent: read all 3 successfully (9.7MB each, noise images), replied "OK"
- user: view sheet4-11.png, reply OK only
- agent: all 8 reads failed (16.49MB > 10MB limit); explained and offered `sips` downscaled copies in `.scratch`
- user: repeated identical request for sheet4-11.png
- agent: ran `ls -l` on the files (output truncated), then read sheet4, 5, 6, and 7 successfully; sheet8-11 pending
